title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: custom engine agents for GCC users
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, agent-block path and Graph operation match the sources read. It correctly warns that the Graph governance API is unavailable in GCC. The general guidance about searching stored agent interactions should also mention the Agent 365 service description's different GCC availability statement.
